description: Atezolizumab is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for untreated metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults if: their tumours have PD-L1 expression on at least 50% of tumour cells or 10% of tumour-infiltrating immune cells; their tumours do not have epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) or anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) mutations; and the company provides atezolizumab according to the commercial arrangement.

extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended atezolizumab, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for untreated metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer in adults whose tumours have PD-L1 expression on at least 50% of tumour cells or at least 10% of tumour-infiltrating immune cells, and whose tumours do not have EGFR or ALK mutations. Atezolizumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
